A '''waste recycler''' was a technological device that could break down and recycle any liquid or solid bodily waste. Due to their working conditions, long-haul [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] miners often had such devices incorporated in their suits. Similarly, the [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|life-supporting armor]] worn by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was equipped with a waste recycler so he would not have to remove the suit in order to use the [[Refresher/Legends|refresher]].
